clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Stormpike needs the Filthy Paws supplies back from Silver Stream Mine. The Miners' League stored equipment there after the ore ran dry, but kobolds have overrun the tunnels. Stormpike wants the tools recovered before his warriors attack.

Silver Stream Mine lies in the hills of northern Loch Modan, east of Algaz Station. Its last silver veins ran dry long ago. The dwarven Miners' League turned the empty shafts into a depot for spare excavation gear, picks, and staging materials. Across Khaz Modan, sturdy tunnels make good storehouses, as long as they stay guarded and locked against the wilderness.

Kobolds have slipped into the mine as dwarven vigilance across Loch Modan has thinned. The dark shafts and gleaming iron tools drew the scavengers, and they soon made the depot their warren. Mountaineer Stormpike is ready to lead warriors in and drive them out, but their heavy boots and sweeping blows could smash the crates. You can slip or fight your way inside to recover the League's supplies before the assault begins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things. It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.
The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine. Good luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have that Miners' Gear, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there? I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine. The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
